scripts.dev: nodemon --watch ../fuel-backend/src --watch ../fuel-backend/server.mjs --watch src --watch index.html --watch vite.config.js --watch tailwind.config.cjs --watch postcss.config.cjs --ext js,jsx,mjs,cjs,html,css --signal SIGTERM --exec node scripts/dev-runner.mjs
scripts.build:android: pnpm run native:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.run:android: pnpm run native:sync && cap run android
scripts.build:local: VITE_APP_MODE=coach vite build --config vite.config.js && node scripts/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs sw dist --app fuel && node scripts/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs splash dist --app fuel
scripts.build:cloud: VITE_APP_MODE=client vite build --config vite.config.cjs && pnpm run stamp:sw
scripts.deploy:cloud: pnpm run build:cloud && firebase deploy --only hosting:client --project fitness-aos
scripts.firebase: pnpm run build:firebase && pnpm run deploy:firebase
scripts.stamp:sw: node scripts/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs sw dist-firebase --app fuel && node scripts/mini-app-shell/cli.mjs splash dist-firebase --app fuel
scripts.build:solo:log: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_SOLO=log vite build --config vite.config.cjs && node scripts/stamp-solo.mjs log
scripts.build:solo:log:shutter: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_SOLO=log VITE_SOLO_FRONTDOOR=shutter vite build --config vite.config.cjs
scripts.build:solo:supplements: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_SOLO=supplements vite build --config vite.config.cjs && node scripts/stamp-solo.mjs supplements
scripts.build:solo:micros: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_SOLO=micros vite build --config vite.config.cjs && node scripts/stamp-solo.mjs micros
scripts.build:solo:report: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_SOLO=report vite build --config vite.config.cjs && node scripts/stamp-solo.mjs report
scripts.build:solo: pnpm run build:solo:log && pnpm run build:solo:supplements && pnpm run build:solo:micros && pnpm run build:solo:report
scripts.deploy:solo:log: pnpm run build:solo:log && firebase deploy --only hosting:log --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:solo:supplements: pnpm run build:solo:supplements && firebase deploy --only hosting:supplements --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:solo:mikros: pnpm run build:solo:micros && firebase deploy --only hosting:mikros --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:solo:protokoll: pnpm run build:solo:report && firebase deploy --only hosting:protokoll --project fitness-aos
